source.title: Composer ™ for Harmony Function Code Application Manual Volume 1 (Function Codes 1 to 174)

name: BCD Output
description: This block converts a real input to boolean outputs by converting the input to binary coded decimal (BCD) format. The input can be scaled with a gain factor, then truncated to an integer value before the BCD conversion occurs. After conversion, the outputs write to an IMDSO14 or IMDSO15 module.
description_lines: This block converts a real input to boolean outputs by convert-
